depth_targets.title: Subscription overview (get, rename) over ARM
limitations: Vyomi simulates exactly one subscription — renaming it changes the one simulated subscription's display name rather than creating or listing an independent additional subscription. Offer/Offer ID are a fixed Pay-As-You-Go quotaId (subscriptionPolicies), matching how the real portal looks them up; Parent management group and Secure score are not modeled (no management-group hierarchy or Microsoft Defender scoring exist in Vyomi).

depth_targets.title: Activity log
limitations: Only console/SDK-triggered mutations made since the simulation booted are recorded, and `caller` is a fixed placeholder identity.

depth_targets.title: Access control (IAM) — role assignments, roles and checkAccess
limitations: Role assignments are real ARM resources scoped to the subscription they were created under (list + checkAccess only see assignments at that scope, with the same wildcard, scope-inheritance and explicit-deny-wins semantics as the Entra RBAC engine), and the Roles tab + checkAccess cover the built-in Owner/Contributor/Reader/… roles plus any custom role definitions. But checkAccess is a standalone decision tool: no other ARM call in Vyomi consults it, so every other data-plane/control-plane operation still succeeds regardless of what is assigned. Deny assignments and classic administrators are always empty.

depth_targets.title: Deployments (Microsoft.Resources/deployments) history, subscription scope
limitations: Deployment creation resolves `[parameters(...)]`/`[variables(...)]` to literal values and actually PUTs every resource listed in properties.template.resources through the same ARM dispatcher, so a deployment really provisions something — but no other ARM template function (concat/resourceId/reference/copy loops) or dependsOn ordering is evaluated, so templates using them fail at the dependent resource's own validation. Cancel always returns a conflict because every deployment completes synchronously before a Cancel call can arrive (the same conflict a real deployment that finished first returns); Redeploy re-runs the same stored template for real.

depth_targets.title: Usage + quotas
limitations: Per-resource-type, per-location compute/network quota (Microsoft.Compute usages) is not modeled — Vyomi has no fixed quantity caps to report against.

depth_targets.title: Diagnose and solve problems, Security, Events, Advisor recommendations, Invoices, Partner information, Programmatic deployment, Billing properties, Preview features, Policies, Management certificates, My permissions, Deployment stacks, Support + Troubleshooting
limitations: These subscription blade menu items are billing-account, Microsoft Defender, Azure Policy, Microsoft Entra or classic Service Management features with no Vyomi backend.
